%% Hand-authored circuitikz figure -- NOT generated by maestro2tex, placed by it via
%% the `order` list in configs/anatop_tb_tia.json. Topology transcribed from
%% simarchive/anatop_tb_tia/tia_2026-07-28/Interactive.9/1/<TB>/netlist/input.scs
%% Supplies, the TCBias/LCBias trim buses and En are omitted -- identical in every
%% bench and carrying no measurement.
\begin{figure}[htbp]
  \centering
  \resizebox{0.50\linewidth}{!}{%
\ctikzset{bipoles/length=1.0cm, resistors/scale=0.85, capacitors/scale=0.85, sources/scale=0.85}
\begin{circuitikz}[
    every node/.append style={font=\footnotesize},
    nlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=1.5pt},
    opt/.style={font=\scriptsize, text=black!55, align=center, inner sep=2pt},
    railnode/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=1.05pt},
    prb/.style={draw, circle, minimum size=9pt, inner sep=0pt},
  ]
  \node[op amp] (C) at (0,0) {};
  \node at (C.center) {\footnotesize A2};
  %% Input pins leave horizontally; every branch that meets them is placed at the
  %% pin height with (x,0 |- pin) so no run is ever diagonal.
  \coordinate (Cp) at (C.+);
  \coordinate (Cm) at (C.-);
  \coordinate (VINM) at (-3.0,0 |- Cm);
  \coordinate (VCM)  at (-4.6,0 |- Cm);
  \draw (C.-) -- (VCM);
  \node[railnode] at (VINM){};
  \node[nlab, above=3pt] at (VINM){\texttt{V\_InM}};
  \draw (VCM) to[V, l_=$V_{\mathrm{CM}}$] (-4.6,-2.6) node[ground]{};
  \draw (VINM) to[V, l_=pulse] (-3.0,-1.5);
  \draw (-3.0,-1.5) -- (-1.6,-1.5) -- (-1.6,0 |- Cp) -- (C.+);
  \draw (C.out) -- (1.6,0);
  \node[railnode] at (1.6,0){};
  \node[nlab, below right] at (1.7,-0.05){\texttt{V\_OutOL}};
  \draw (1.6,0) -- (3.0,0);
  \draw (3.0,0) to[C, l=$C_L$] (3.0,-2.6) node[ground]{};
\end{circuitikz}
  }
  \caption[{Open-loop slew testbench, \texttt{SlewOpenLoopTB}.}]{Open-loop slew testbench, \texttt{SlewOpenLoopTB}. The inverting input is held at \(V_{\mathrm{CM}}\) and a floating pulse source drives the pair differentially rail to rail, into \(C_L=\SI{5}{\pico\farad}\). With no feedback the output is driven hard in both directions, so the slew rates of Table~\ref{tab:tia-tran} are open-loop full-swing values and bound the closed-loop settling rate rather than equalling it.}
  \label{fig:tb-slew}
\end{figure}
